# Keenable

Keenable provides web search and page extraction APIs with authenticated production routes and keyless public evaluation routes.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/keenable/.

## Actions

- **Fetch URL** (read-only): Fetch one public web URL as extracted markdown with the connected Keenable workspace.
- **Fetch URL Publicly** (read-only): Fetch one public web URL as extracted markdown without an API key through Keenable's public evaluation pool.
- **Search Web** (read-only): Search the web with the connected Keenable workspace and return one bounded, ranked result set.
- **Search Web Publicly** (read-only): Search the web without an API key through Keenable's public evaluation pool.
